video_procedure: Add a reviewed video by setting videos.en or videos.bn on the article policy to an 11 character YouTube id. Do not paste an iframe into Markdown. Set that route's video_status to configured and record who reviewed the spoken language. Run node scripts/check-help-content.mjs. A Bangla article shows an English-only video with a spoken-language caption. Leave video_status not_configured until a real reviewed id exists. Do not invent an id.
